content.short: Bonfida provides a front-end for Serum and Solana with bots, domain names, charts, market orders, and an API for Serum transactions and on-chain trading bots.
content.description: Bonfida is a product suite that delivers a user-friendly front-end experience for Serum and Solana. The suite brings together tools such as trading bots, domain-name services, interactive charts, and the ability to place market orders. Users can quickly navigate markets, monitor data visually, and automate workflows through a cohesive interface. For developers, the Bonfida API provides access to a unique repository of all Serum transactions and the means to build on-chain trading bots, enabling custom integrations and programmatic market activity.
